identityConfidence: ORGANISATION: HIGH. Sri Adichunchanagiri Shikshana Trust was established in 1973 by Sri Sri Sri Ramanandanatha Mahaswamiji, peethadhikari of the Sri Adichunchanagiri Mahasamsthana Math, Nagamangala Taluk, Mandya District. It runs a large network of medical, engineering, nursing, pharmacy, Ayurvedic, management and general-education institutions, and Nirmalananda Swamiji is its current President and Chancellor of Adichunchanagiri University.
